svg.title: Onboarding and offboarding checklists — SoftTrack web design mockup (#255)
svg.desc: A new hire’s first week is a list that lives in somebody’s head, and leaving is the same list backwards. HR keeps checklist templates whose items have an owner and a due date counted from the start date; starting onboarding gives each item to a real person; the new hire sees their own; and offboarding hands over open tickets and asks for the account to be deactivated.
svg.text: · the first week, and the last, written down

g.text: Settings → People operations → Onboarding, signed in as Grace
The first week, and the last, as a list that lives somewhere other than somebody’s head.

svg.text: Leaving is the same list backwards

g.text: Then: return equipment, revoke API tokens, remove from teams,
and ask the site admin to deactivate the account.

svg.text: Done when HR can keep checklist templates with items that have a title, an owner role and a due date counted from the start date; starting onboarding creates a checklist with real
people and dates; the new hire sees their items on their home page and others see theirs; HR sees every joiner’s progress; offboarding counts back from the last day and lists the
person’s open tickets to reassign; and an item can link to a ticket.
